headline: Ghana Stock Exchange Gains 1.38% in October Led by MTN Ghana
summary: The GSE Composite Index closed October with a 1.38% weekly gain, driven primarily by gains in telecommunications firm MTN Ghana.
why: MTN Ghana is the dominant constituent on the Ghana Stock Exchange by market capitalization.

impacts.name: GSE Composite Index
impacts.why: Strong performance from telecom giant MTN Ghana lifted the benchmark index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
